supporting_observations.claim: From 13:33 through 13:48 UTC, svc-claimsync generated repeated failed network logons from FILE-HD-01, with invalid-password status. The events recur at roughly one-minute intervals and show the same process ID and source address.
Domain-controller events also report invalid-password failures for svc-claimsync from FILE-HD-01 during this period.

The timing and cadence of the failures are consistent with the supplied context that svc-claimsync re-authenticates every minute and was scheduled for password rotation at 13:30 UTC; stale credentials after rotation are a plausible explanation, but the logs do not prove this was the cause.

At 14:07 UTC, an explicit-credentials event on WS-OHADDAD-01 records SYSTEM using svc-claimsync credentials with target server PROXY-HD-01; the reported process is Commvault GxCVD.exe. This is outside the stated ClaimSync service-account use on FILE-HD-01 and merits investigation.
The 14:07 event does not by itself establish that authentication to the proxy succeeded or that the credentials were used maliciously.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy telemetry for PROXY-HD-01 was not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a log collection outage; this window includes the 14:07 explicit-credentials event.
The supplied event records do not show whether the proxy authentication succeeded or what activity, if any, followed the credential use.
